title: Number 137 in the proportions of the second pyramid

tellings.quote: You surely haven't failed to notice the correspondence with the number found in the proportions of the second pyramid of Giza.

plain: The number 137 shows up in the proportions of the second pyramid at Giza, the one built for the pharaoh Khafre, says a researcher named Armando Mei, who tells Michels the match is too plain to miss. He draws the link from the physicists Richard Feynman and Leon Lederman, who wrote about 137 as a mysterious number at the heart of physics, though he gives no source for the pyramid measurement itself. If true, the builders would have known something about the deep structure of nature.
